speaker: Government Representative
text: Welcome to the Republic of Arcadia.

speaker: Government Representative
text: I hope your journey across the Conan Sea was not too exhausting.

speaker: Government Representative
text: You are arriving at a critical moment for our country

speaker: Government Representative
text: Our industries continue to grow, our ports are busier than ever, and our energy demand is rising faster each year.

speaker: Government Representative
text: That is precisely why the Ministry requested your expertise for the Offshore Wind Energy in the Conan Sea project.

speaker: Government Representative
text: The future of Arcadia’s energy transition may depend on the decisions you make here.
